steps: Apply as a LawnGuru provider (vetting, background check, equipment review, proof of insurance).
Get job alerts in your service area; view payout information upfront for mowing/snow jobs or submit free quotes for custom jobs.
Claim jobs that fit your route and schedule them.
Complete the job and upload the photo receipt in the app.
Payout auto-deposits to your bank: within 48 hours as Preferred/Elite Pro, within 5 days as a new provider.
timing: Preferred and Elite Pros: payout within 48 hours of job completion. New providers: within 5 days. Automatic bank deposit via Stripe; ACH moves on banking days.
payout_value_note: variable per-task pay shown in-app before accepting; no fixed amount in official terms

who_pays: The customer pays through LawnGuru — you see your payout before claiming a job, and payouts are auto-deposited to your bank via Stripe.
who_qualifies: A smartphone; your own equipment and transportation; proof of liability insurance; an application plus vetting and a background check.
work_available: Jobs are posted in the app and you claim them into your route; supply depends on customer demand in your service area.
what_gets_accepted: Complete the job as booked. There's a zero-tolerance one-strike policy for listed violations. For select services LawnGuru sets pricing from regional market data; for custom jobs you quote your own price.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No platform fees stated, but the real costs are yours: your own equipment, transportation, and liability insurance. Unpaid time: building your route between jobs and the vetting process before your first job.
when_cash_arrives: Preferred and Elite Pros: within 48 hours of job completion. New providers: within 5 days. Automatic bank deposit via Stripe; ACH moves on banking days, so weekend jobs settle the next banking day.
